metadata.title: 5th Grade English (Agglika E-Dimotikou) – Key Vocabulary by CEFR
metadata.method: 3 subagents for extraction + pymupdf parsing of Oxford lists (4951 lemmas) + lemmatization (plurals, -ing/-ed, irregulars) + phrase headword rule + country/culture OOV rules
metadata.note_off_list: OFF = not in Oxford 3000/5000 PDFs (e.g. christmas, zoo, pizza, gorilla are genuinely absent from those PDFs). See classroom_level_estimate per OFF entry: most are child-core A1-A2, a minority are truly B2+.
metadata.note_proper: Countries/nationalities/capitals mapped to A1 via country-rule; Greek culture proper (acropolis, parthenon, etc.) mapped to B1 via culture-rule.
